description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Raydar is recruiting on behalf of an unnamed fast-growing software company. The Full Stack Software Engineer will build and deliver product features across backend services, infrastructure, and the user interface, while working with users and developing AI-powered components.
Full-stack product engineer building AI-powered applications and shipping user-informed features

Responsibilities:
• Ship features end to end, from backend and infrastructure services to the frontend user experience
• Stay in regular contact with users, learn what they need and fold those insights into rapid product updates
• Build and refine AI-powered components using large language models
• Offer input that influences the direction of the product
• Take ownership of problems across the whole stack with minimal supervision

Requirements:
• 1 to 4 years of engineering experience
• Strong proficiency in TypeScript and React
• Backend experience, not solely frontend work
• Experience at an early-stage startup, ideally through a period of growth; big tech candidates considered if they show clear startup intent and a drive to build from zero to one
• Demonstrated interest in AI and large language models through work or personal projects
• A computer science degree or equivalent technical background with solid fundamentals
• High agency and the ability to ramp up within a month with little hand-holding
• Existing work authorization is required; transfers are accepted

Preferred:
• Background as an early engineer or founder at a startup
• Infrastructure, DevOps or SRE experience
• Experience with browser automation, developer tools or QA
• Degree from a top computer science program
